description: This Java class, EntityConditionUtils, provides auxiliary static methods used within the ORM framework of Apache OFBiz for handling entity condition expressions. It includes utility methods for retrieving model fields and adding values to SQL condition buffers, facilitating dynamic query construction.

classes.name: EntityConditionUtils
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods to assist in building and handling entity condition expressions within OFBiz's ORM layer.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelField object for a given field name from a ModelEntity, returning null if the ModelEntity is null.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an SQL buffer with optional parameter list, delegating to SqlJdbcUtil.addValue, and handling null parameter list by passing null.
